messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 alert — spike in 5xx errors for tenant `qc-prod` in dedicated VPC pool `qc-vpc-1`. Canary rollout of artifact `qc-model:2026-03-15-abc123` shows elevated error-rate (50% 500s over baseline) — routing group: canary-10%. Please acknowledge and assign on-call.

devon-oncall: acked. paging SRE oncall. I'm on pager, taking initial triage.

maria.ops: seeing same in infra dashboards — multi-instance 503s returned from model-serving pods in qc-vpc-1. Latency also up ~200ms p95.

kai-sre: I'm digging into pod logs now. suspect regression in model-serving image handling of long context ⇢ OOM? Pulling kube events.

sara-eng: @devon-oncall @kai-sre adding context: this canary was a pinned artifact rollout requested by QuantumCare last week to enable some tokenization optimization. They asked for a staged 10% canary.

quantumcare-support: we are seeing user complaints — several calls timed out and some batch jobs failed. No PII exposures, but business-critical transactions retried and delayed. Please advise ETA for mitigation.

devon-oncall: immediate mitigation plan: 1) stop canary ramp (set canary to 0%), 2) pin all qc-prod traffic to previous stable artifact `qc-model:2026-03-08-stable`, 3) isolate affected tenant if errors persist. Executing step 1 now.

deploy-bot: Received request: `canary:set canary-10% -> 0% for rollout qc-vpc-1`. Command queued.

devon-oncall: run command to stop canary and pin back to stable:
```
# stop canary
redwood rollout set --pool qc-vpc-1 --policy canary --weight 0
# pin tenant to stable artifact
redwood tenant set-artifact --tenant qc-prod --artifact qc-model:2026-03-08-stable
```

deploy-bot: canary weight set -> 0. Pin operation in progress. Applying image pin for tenant `qc-prod`.

maria.ops: I see the rollout command completed, pin call returned success, kube: `Deployment qc-model` updated for tenant routing rules. Starting to drain canary pods gracefully.

kai-sre: logs after pin show fewer 5xx already — some pods still reporting transient errors while old connections drain. Will monitor.

quantumcare-support: thanks — we still see two critical customers with queued jobs. Any chance to prioritize them?

devon-oncall: @quantumcare-support we can temporarily direct those tenants' traffic to a warm reserved node in the dedicated pool (manual route override). Steps inbound.

maria.ops: creating override route:
```
# route override for high-priority customer ids
redwood route override --tenant qc-cust-42 --target reserved-node-09 --reason "emergency retry"
redwood route override --tenant qc-cust-77 --target reserved-node-09 --reason "emergency retry"
```

deploy-bot: route overrides applied. Traffic now directed to reserved-node-09.

kai-sre: monitoring reserved node — healthy and handling retries. Error rate for qc-prod down from 50% -> 2% in last 2 minutes. Latency trending to baseline.

oliver-pm: updating QuantumCare stakeholders. @quantumcare-support can you confirm whether key flows are recovering on your side?

quantumcare-support: confirmed — queued jobs draining, customers reporting successful retries. Thanks for the fast response. Please follow up with RCA and timeline for full validation.

devon-oncall: Next steps: 1) keep pin in place until sara-eng verifies the artifact regression and we get a patched release, 2) run smoke tests across the dedicated pool and run an extended canary internally, 3) handoff follow-up to Kai for post-incident analysis and to Maria for traffic audits.

sara-eng: I've started reproducing the failure locally against `qc-model:2026-03-15-abc123`. Early repro shows tokenizer drop when context > 8k tokens leads to segfault in native layer. I'll open a fix PR, but patch ETA ~4 hours.

kai-sre: I'll own the postmortem and mitigation checklist. I'll also validate rollback pin persisted across control-plane restarts and audit all tenants still on canary (should be zero).

maria.ops: I'll run an audit script and share the list: `scripts/audit_pinned_tenants.sh --pool qc-vpc-1`.

devon-oncall: handing off pager — @kai-sre you're now primary oncall for the follow-up. I'll remain available for escalation.

kai-sre: acknowledged, taking oncall. Adding timeline notes and incident severity -> P1 in incident tracker.

oliver-pm: scheduling customer follow-up call at +2h to confirm remediation plan and timeline for patch deployment.

sara-eng: PR opened: `fix/tokenizer-bounds-check` — CI running. If green we'll coordinate a canary with a small internal subset before re-introducing to quantumcare.

quantumcare-support: appreciate the quick rollback and the routing overrides. Please keep us in the loop for the patch and ETA so we can brief execs.

kai-sre: closing this thread as mitigation successful for now. Will attach metrics screenshots and logs to the incident tracker before EOD. /cc @maria.ops @sara-eng :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident P1 (2188888000) transitioned -> mitigated. Owner: kai-sre. Postmortem required.
